summary.text: Suzanne Weber is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 16, which her legislative page associates with Tillamook.
Her biography describes a 30-year career teaching first through third grade and service as mayor of Tillamook.

paragraphs.text: Weber moved to Tillamook in 1970 and taught young children for 30 years, according to her biography.
She has operated two small businesses and served on the Tillamook City Council and then as mayor, where she focused on economic development for rural communities.
